Once that's done, it would be fantastic if you could check the tire pressures as well—I'd love to share my impressive car maintenance skills with my Twitter followers with the message 'Just filled up the tank and checked the tire pressures. Ready for the next adventure!'. If you could also start up the engine and let me know the battery voltage and fuel level, that would be incredibly helpful.
